tiers.name: economy
tiers.summary: Lowest cost; the current rationale-bearing tier is not yet measured
tiers.evidenceDetail: No live measurement of this effective configuration. RC1.3 measured the explicit zero-LLM profile (semanticMode: none) at parity with Basic; the current tier adds a rationale call and system-dedup framing, so that result does not transfer. The mechanism is supported; the end-to-end quality and cost of this tier are not measured.
tiers.finding: no measurement of the current effective config

tiers.name: balanced
tiers.summary: A small premium for a larger verbatim tail
tiers.evidenceDetail: No live measurement. The mechanism is supported by the engine (retention is a tested policy key) but the END-TO-END steadiness benefit is unmeasured. RC2.1 ran the one critical A/B for it — economy vs balanced, retention isolated — and reports the result.
tiers.finding: no measurement of the current effective config

tiers.name: quality
tiers.summary: A larger premium for a larger tail AND narrative checkpoints
tiers.evidenceDetail: No live measurement. Composed of two supported capabilities; neither the combined nor the individual steadiness benefit has been measured, and the rationale half carries an auxiliary call per fold plus the retention cost on every request.
tiers.finding: no measurement of the current effective config

note: RC1.3 measured semanticMode: none. The current economy tier is rationale-bearing, so it is a hypothesis. No tier value changed.
